findings.evidenceJa: 元凶を叩いて止めさせる
findings.governingReading: strike down the source and force it to stop
findings.explanation: The urgent plan to defeat the responsible party and halt the field becomes vague retrieval of a “cause.”

findings.evidenceJa: 手分けして校舎を探そう
findings.governingReading: let us split up and search the school building
findings.explanation: Shirou’s risky proposal that they divide the search disappears.

findings.highlight: She says we should call for Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを呼ぶって言ったって
findings.governingReading: Even if we say we will call Saber
findings.explanation: Shirou’s internal objection to the idea becomes prior dialogue spoken by Rin.

findings.highlight: Saber should be able to beat that Servant
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは確実に勝利できる
findings.governingReading: Saber can defeat that Servant with certainty
findings.explanation: Shirou’s overconfident certainty is weakened to ordinary expectation.

findings.evidenceJa: 左手の甲が熱く焼ける
findings.governingReading: the back of my left hand burns hot
findings.explanation: The exact bodily site of Command Spell expenditure disappears.
The spatial deformation from which Saber manifests becomes an unrelated void.

findings.highlight: I can’t say for sure, but that’s what I feel.
findings.evidenceJa: 断定はできないけど、わたしはそう感じてる
findings.governingReading: I cannot say for certain, but that is what I sense: the field’s origin is on the first floor
findings.explanation: The English immediately contradicts Rin’s explicit uncertainty with “has to be.”
